nodes.name: Daily 7 AM Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs after the 6 AM Pacific pipeline import. Adjust cron to match your schedule.

nodes.name: Set API Base URL
nodes.notes: Change baseUrl if using a different Railway environment.

nodes.name: 1. Start AI Scoring
nodes.notes: POST /internal/ai-scoring — returns pipeline_run_id and poll_url. Requires ALLOW_MANUAL_PIPELINE=true on Railway.

nodes.name: 2. Wait 30 Seconds
nodes.notes: Initial delay before first status poll.

nodes.name: 3–5. Poll Step Status
nodes.notes: Polls GET /internal/steps/{pipeline_run_id} until done=true or 10 attempts.

meta.description: Replaces single HTTP Request AI scoring node. POST starts background scoring, polls /internal/steps/{pipeline_run_id} up to 10 times (30s apart), then sends Telegram with total_tenders_scored.
